senses.gloss: m. (גהץ) calendering clothes, fine laundry work.
units: Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ bot. איזהו ג׳ כלי וכ׳ the process called gihuts applies to woolen garments when they are new, and to white linen garments when laundried.

<cite ref="Taanit 29b:6">Taan. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ שלנו ככיבוס שלהם</he> (Ms. M. always <cite ref="C00694"><he>גִּיחוּץ</he></cite>) our (Babylonian) laundry work is like their (Palestinean) plain wash.
<cite ref="Taanit 29b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אין בהן משום ג׳</he> are not included in the prohibition of laundry work (in the festive week &c.).
